profile.name: Livox三维激光雷达
profile.description: Livox三维激光雷达是一类用于获取空间三维点云的激光传感器，可输出点的坐标、距离/角度表示、反射率、回波信息，以及部分记录中的IMU数据。它常用于实验室中的三维扫描、机器人感知、空间测绘、目标检测和点云重建。
profile.description_en: Livox 3D LiDAR is a laser-based spatial sensor used to acquire 3D point clouds. It can provide point coordinates, range/angle representations, reflectivity, return information, and in some recordings IMU data. In laboratories it is commonly used for 3D scanning, robotic perception, spatial mapping, object detection, and point-cloud reconstruction.
